updates.title: Goodwin Generated Mission America opens in Honolulu
updates.body: Will begins the first marathon of the 50-state sequence.

updates.title: Alaska transfer window complete
updates.body: The team moves from the island start into the frontier leg and toward the mainland.

updates.title: Mainland rhythm begins in Oregon
updates.body: Run, recover, travel, reset becomes the operating cadence.

updates.title: Pacific Northwest double begins
updates.body: Washington and Utah put the early logistics stack under pressure.

updates.title: Mountain states underway
updates.body: Idaho and Montana mark the first sustained altitude and travel block.

updates.title: Dakotas complete
updates.body: The route turns toward Wyoming, Nebraska, and the central push.
